⭐ 1 STAR — BE VERY CAREFUL: £10.99 EVERY WEEK

I only discovered the charges after the money had already been taken from my account. I cancelled it immediately and requested a refund, but my refund was refused.

I never intended to take out this weekly subscription. Please check exactly what you’re agreeing to before proceeding.
